children.text: If there is a lot of noise, please adjust the "Microphone Sensitivity Adjustment" option in the voice settings.
Adjusting the Speed of Voice Transmission

children.tooltip: 1. Try adjusting the voice transmission speed when the network is slow and the voice sounds broken.            2. Also, when there is a delay in the delivery of yours or the other party’s voices, try adjusting the voice transmission speed.
